The runner and observer are unchanged at the new pin; the bump keeps the harness commit at the specimens' tree after the 0100/0101/0101a fixes. A proposed runner change that would have recorded the applied configuration text (better-borg-c PR 435) was closed as mis-filed and is not needed: configuration_sha256 already identifies what a run applied.
live watchdog read could abort a run on a split UTF-8 character (better-borg-c#220); fixed by 56ccf741. The observer is unchanged between the two pins.

harness.note: The better-borg-c runner and observer at this commit build and run every specimen. A specimen is the game and Borg source at its own ref; the observer instrumentation comes from the harness commit. It applies to specimens of kind "better-borg-c" (the default). Specimens of kind "borg-rs" are built and run by borg-rs's own harness at the specimen's ref (harness/build.sh and the borgh frontend). This pin is also a specimen ref (4.2.6-bbc-9ca98661): the harness bumped with the mode-cutoff restart so runner and specimens move together (borg-zoo#54).

experiment.prespecified:
Fixed 2026-11-22, before any result of this build was read (borg-zoo#618; borg-reborn-rs #870). Same pinned source in both
arms, all other resolved settings identical; arrows keep attack_arrow_point_blank_divisor. Pilot (RULES 16) on classes-18,
18 starts per arm (36 cells), 100,000 turns, evidence retained; then small + medium (classes-1800 starts 1-360, 360 paired
starts) on the owner's go.
Gate: no config_error; one binary; params-core.json and settings-resolved.json record the intended resolved throw values
(inherit: 0 resolving to the arrow divisor, throw1: 1); every cell ends in death, turn_cap or borg_stopped; stalls apart.
Primary (tactical): deaths by 100,000 turns, all attempts retained. Progress guardrails: mean CL and mean max depth of
throw1 may each fall by no more than 0.25 against inherit. Report per class and in aggregate; rescued and newly killed
pairs, keys-identical pairs and denominators; every unfinished game. Diagnostics: oil thrown per run (inventory use plus
"Throwing painful object" notes); deaths to fast monsters, and the cases with a visible awake fast monster adjacent at the
last recorded decision before death (adjacency and speed read from the trace and screen, unobservable cases stated as such,
never inferred from the cause name); changed native throw choices against changed scores only. Named case: start 1705507033
(race 7, class 4). The fast-fragile planner already bypasses conservation policy. Not a claim of improvement: a
confirmation needs a new unopened seed block (classes-1800-b has been read).
